import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static int[][] a;
    static int[] b;
    static int[] f, g;
    static int[] mp;
    static int[] tot;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v;
    static int m, M;

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = (int)((long)ans * a % mod);
            a = (int)((long)a * a % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] arr, int idx) {
        if (arr[idx] < 0) arr[idx] += mod;
        if (arr[idx] >= mod) arr[idx] -= mod;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] = (a[i] + a[i + lim]) % mod;
            reduce(a, i);
        }
        fwt(a, lim);
        fwt(a, lim);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] = (a[i] - a[i + lim] + mod) % mod;
            reduce(a, i);
        }
        fwt2(a, lim);
        fwt2(a, lim);
    }

    static int pc(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }

    static int fac(int x) {
        return x == 0 ? 1 : fac(x - 1) * x;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return fac(n) / fac(m) / fac(n - m);
    }

    static void process_half(int start_row, int num_rows, int[] arr, int target_size) {
        int total_bits = num_rows * n;
        int limit = 1 << total_bits;
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; ++i) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[num_rows];
            for (int j = 0; j < total_bits; ++j) {
                int bit = (i >> j) & 1;
                int val = bit == 1 ? b[j + start_row * n] : (mod + 1 - b[j + start_row * n]) % mod;
                p = (int)((long)p * val % mod);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < num_rows; ++j) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[target_size]) {
                int[] s = new int[target_size];
                int cnt = 0;
                int temp = j;
                while (temp != 0) {
                    int lsb = temp & -temp;
                    s[cnt++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(lsb);
                    temp ^= lsb;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, cnt);
                // generate all permutations of s
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < target_size; ++jj) {
                        if ((S[jj] >> s[jj] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        int idx;
                        if (target_size == m) {
                            idx = mp[j];
                        } else {
                            idx = mp[(~j) & ((1 << n) - 1)];
                        }
                        st |= 1 << idx;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s));
            }
            arr[st] = (arr[st] + p) % mod;
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] a) {
        int i = a.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = a.length - 1;
        while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
        swap(a, i, j);
        reverse(a, i + 1, a.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] a, int i, int j) {
        int t = a[i];
        a[i] = a[j];
        a[j] = t;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] a, int l, int r) {
        while (l < r) {
            swap(a, l, r);
            l++;
            r--;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = in.nextInt();
        a = new int[n][n];
        b = new int[n * n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                a[i][j] = in.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int)((long)a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }
        v = new ArrayList[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        mp = new int[1 << n];
        tot = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
            int cnt = pc(i);
            v[cnt].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[cnt]++;
        }
        m = n / 2;
        M = n - m;
        int sizeF = 1 << tot[m];
        f = new int[sizeF];
        process_half(0, m, f, m);
        int sizeG = 1 << tot[m];
        g = new int[sizeG];
        process_half(m, M, g, M);
        fwt(f, sizeF);
        fwt(g, sizeG);
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeF; ++i) {
            f[i] = (int)((long)f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        }
        fwt2(f, sizeF);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < sizeF; ++i) {
            ans = (ans + f[i]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
